name: The Lamp Lit at Delphi
description: A clay lamp whose wick has burned for two centuries on a single fill of oil.
benefit: Lights a ruin without fuel and shows what the light was not meant to show.
cost: It cannot be put out, so it betrays the bearer in any dark place they hope to move through unseen.

name: The Ichor Cruet
description: A flask of gold glass, stoppered with wax, that warms in the hand.
benefit: Refills the full charge of the one who drinks from it.
cost: A single dose only, and it takes a measure of the drinker's own vitality in exchange.

name: Votive Bowl of Eleusis
description: A shallow bowl in which something was offered, often, and was always accepted.
benefit: Doubles the standing earned by any offering poured into it at a sanctuary.
cost: It takes the offering whole, and the offering is gone whether or not the god is listening.

name: Phial of the Last Breath
description: A glass tube, stoppered while its owner still had something to say.
benefit: Brings the bearer back from a killing blow once, with half their vitality.
cost: Breaks in doing so. The next death is permanent, and the bearer knows it.

name: Flask of Styx Water
description: A narrow flask that has never been opened and has never been dry.
benefit: A swallow lets the drinker take a binding oath that cannot be broken by anyone else.
cost: The oath is real. The drinker is held to it, and so is whoever they swore it to.

name: The Kykeon Draught
description: Barley, mint and water, mixed by someone who was told the proportions in a dream.
benefit: Quiets hunger, fear and pain for a full day.
cost: It also quiets the instinct for danger; the drinker walks into trouble calmly and late.

name: Salt Cure of the Flood Widows
description: A sealed jar of coarse grey salt that keeps anything, including what should not be kept.
benefit: Preserves food, hides and even the dead for a full season without rot.
cost: It is heavy, it draws every scavenger in the district, and it cannot be used to preserve anything the bearer plans to eat.

name: Whistle of the Last Hound
description: Bone, hollowed. No dog answers it any more, but something does.
benefit: Calls the one guide the world still has, and the bearer walks the road safely to the next shrine.
cost: Each blast is heard for miles. What follows the guide cannot be told apart from what followed the dog.

name: The Ore-Heart
description: A fist of refined ore in a lead cradle. It has a pulse.
benefit: Holds a hundred charges, and gives them to whoever carries it.
cost: It weighs eleven kilograms and everyone who can smell power knows where it is.

name: Satrapal Salve
description: A foreign ointment in a green pot, used by a court physician who is no longer at court.
benefit: Closes a wound at once, and keeps it closed.
cost: The pot holds four doses. The fifth will not come, and the foreign court that makes it knows who ran out.
